title: It has been an excellent tool for me!
review_text: I have been using Esewa for years now, and I have found it an amazing assistant in my everyday life.   However, I have this against them: They have reduced their reward point giving policy very significantly. The company can work out better to keep their users in this competitive market.   All the best.
